hazards.evidence: Wooden handrail is present only on the right wall; the left side of the staircase has no rail.
Multiple items on the treads: athletic shoes, a stack of folded towels/linens, and cardboard/paper left on steps.
Stairwell is dim with only one small wall sconce; large areas (especially lower/left) are in deep shadow, reducing visibility for a walker user.
Right-side handrail appears to terminate in a rounded wall return partway up the flight and does not continue to the lower steps near the camera.
